en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, by his chain, from Sama’at Bin Mihran, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one whose fingers move faster than his tongue, so (he will be) counted in his favour’.
en.sarwar: 21. Muhammad ibn al-Hassan has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad through his chain of narrators from Sama‘ah ibn Mehran who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Whoever’ s fingers may move faster than his tongue it is counted in his favor (according to the movement of the former).”’
